title: Punch
blurb: No real fist has ever made this noise. Cinema punches sound like this because reality is disappointing — the genuine article is a dull slap, so foley artists have spent a century hitting sides of meat, leather gloves and phone books to produce something the audience will accept. Editing inherited the whole tradition wholesale. Use it for physical comedy, for verbal knockouts, and for the moment an argument lands like a haymaker somebody had been holding back for three paragraphs. THWACK. The debate has concluded.
